notes.title: Version 0.5.0 - Ragdolls are here!
notes.content: [p]Version 0.5.0 introduces ragdolls! [/p][p][/p][p]Forget about predictable death animations - you can now K.O your opponent in style 🥊[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/a0cef537fd34d39ca5840cc80cc3ce8d520deb38.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can of course still make the enemy fly away based on how hard you hit them! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/02dde822d40d66bb16cdc5ab9d345223ec7bcdc4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Here, have some more gifs![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/16abeb6ef591964fd140eb0f010d5bf04c49d899.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/2d5d8676c0d541f303771809184527b6407b09ce.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you're still reading and curious what else is new, here's a short summary[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A cool new greater charm (in honor of one of our dedicated playtesters)[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother movement animations, most noticable at lower/higher speeds[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements in several areas (boring stuff you want, but don't need to know about)[/p][/*][*][p]The bear elite will no longer push the player (hotfix after 0.5.0 went live)[/p][/*][*][p]A new Elite zombie enemy to get wrecked by[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the Crow Boss Health and damage by a tiny amount to ensure more players can destroy him![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you're STILL reading, you should double check that you joined the Discord channel! <3  [url="https://discord.com/invite/mXfXtEBEER"]https://discord.com/invite/mXfXtEBEER[/url][/p]

notes.title: Version 0.4.5
notes.content: [p]This version brings a lot more content bundled together with some awesome improvements![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved voice lines for event NPCs[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot balancing - you get more varied loot now[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New and refreshing abilities![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Added more shield equipment[/p][/*][*][p][b]IMPORTANT BUG FIXES for gold gain (it's more wild and crazy now)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Talking animations for event NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of new and cool charms (adds cool synergies!!!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New bows for the Rogue[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Improved weapons (more weapons are a part of armor sets now)[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Ability menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a label that display the cost of potions in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed Nightstalker armor for Rogue[/p][/*][*][p]Volume balances for various events[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the price of goblin armor to reflect the rarity[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added starting relics to all characters[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Trials of Valor is on fire 🔥
notes.content:
[p]The game has seen a decent spike in wishlists during this week. That inspired us to polish up the game a bit to prepare it for the upcoming demo. 

Since the game is on fire, it seemed suitable to improve the games fire spells 🔥
[/p][list][*][p]Improved all fire spells visuals and sound effects (MORE TO COME)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new fire spell (Flamethrower)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Warriors "Slam" ability with new effects (VFX and SFX)[/p][/*][*][p]Made the Rogue move faster while shooting with the bow[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new armor set (Goblin armor, both for the Rogue and the Warrior) WIP[/p][/*][*][p]The "Thorn" stat now also appears when playing the Rogue (was exclusive for Warrior before)[/p][/*][*][p]"Thorny" and "Super Thorny" now appears on all armor pieces. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved the voice for the Human Enemy Warrior.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for wishlisting the game! 

If you haven't joined the Discord yet, you're more than welcome to do so!

[url="https://discord.com/invite/mXfXtEBEER"]https://discord.com/invite/mXfXtEBEER[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
[p]This version contains a lot of polish and fixes.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Improved Keybindings menu (reset feature, allow binding more keys)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Main menu scene and lighting[/p][/*][*][p]New Soundtrack in the menu[/p][/*][*][p]Voice lines for Shop NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]More sound effect to events[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced sound levels for many things[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes to the block feature[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes with the mana display on the UI (still not 100% fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Picked better names for the Rogues' boots[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how weapon types are displayed on the tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Sound effects when selecting a charm reward[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some green boxes appearing on certain fight views[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the grass in the dark forest part of the map[/p][/*][*][p]LOTS OF OTHER POLISHED STUFF ːsteamthumbsupː[/p][/*][*][p]Possibly one or many new legendary items ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Enjoy! 

Let me know if you find any bugs! [/p]

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 is live for playtesting! ⚔️
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Version 0.4.0 comes with a lot of important changes that improves the experience when playing the game.[/p][p]
This version overhauls the maps, both in terms of what you see and what happens when you click a node.[/p][p][/p][p]🔴 Gone is the jankiness of zooming into the fight from above. [/p][p]🔴 Gone is the performance cost that comes with having the fights in a huge open landscape.[/p][p]🟢 Here to stay is a smooth transition between the overview scene and the fight scene.   [/p][p]🟢 Here to stay is the performance gain of a more compact fight scene.  [/p][p][/p][p]The new changes also allows for indoor areas, which was really troublesome to have previously. [/p][p][/p][h3]Indoor examples [/h3][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/973583ddbb5855ed37fc348a905c27eaa544853a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/2f777d093490e7ef9c1eb11200ebef821262789d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/073f050b83d53f0f22c1b6d768ba744c0d82e5cf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/39d72675cd1f45a01028f3ba5abe4eac539fb36a.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][/h3][h3]Outdoor examples[/h3][h3]  [/h3][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/6a60863a14e56e01e5a6c193b35d1424ef530e77.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/c4c5172f856503c525318870ee004a9c9cec5be5.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/a3fccbe46b3993fd62496b01589ba4a447d6e31b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/37950b396139d7fef7df6eed280017867cd78c29.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/9715327526b4ad5a27df40b2a9af5ccc3788080c.png"][/img][/carousel][p]
Here's a video showing the new transition between overview and fights
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fxuxEvCW0Vc"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Also, there's this 👀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45692779/d1db425bc36421ce48e5903a1a55b361a0971191.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This update also fixes bugs and improves a lot of things mentioned in feedback during playtests.  I tried composing a list of all the changes, but there's a lot that has changed and I don't think it's worth spending your time reading through all the changes.[/p][p][/p][p][u]If you haven't tried the game yet, or didn't joined the Discord, now's the perfect time to do so![/u]  [/p][p]

notes.title: What's new in Trials of Valor?
notes.content:
[p]Trials of Valor has improved a lot since the trailer release.[/p][p][/p][p]I've gathered a lot of feedback and ideas from different people through social media and playtest sessions.  
[/p][p]I want to begin by expressing my gratitude to all the all the those people! You guys are the best!!! 😀   [/p][p][/p][p]Let's go over what's new. [/p][p][/p][h3]Fighting mechanics ⚔️[/h3][list][*][p]Added “hitstop effects” of various lengths.[/p][/*][*][p]More prominent hit animations.[/p][/*][*][p]The character model “bounces” when hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added lots of particle effects when dealing or taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved pop-up texts in fights with better fonts and colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added many new text types that can pop up during a fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the game more challenging by tweaking rules and values.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the knockback effect to make the characters “slide” less.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved many animations to reduce the “slide” effect mentioned above. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a slow-motion effect that triggers when you die or finish an enemy in a stylish fashion 💃.[/p][/*][*][p]The enemies have been balanced and use cooler abilities. [/p][/*][*][p]The sceen flashes when taking damage (a subtle effect).[/p][/*][*][p]Damaged effect that triggers when very low on health, with a heartbeat sound effect.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="OUgWBDX_j6E;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]And here are some fight pictures if you prefer![/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/d90da68183a46bcfac32dd0b18bff9dac03d9038.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/648f09dc2ee283c317143464f504a2e4b6cad9a0.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/758ad76fb329dc5e42b5a11eef7ccc56fd313816.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]As you can see, a lot of focus has been put into making the fights feel and look epic. They have more visual elements going on now and hitting an enemy with your weapon / spells feels more powerful. [/p][p][/p][h3]UI improvements [/h3][list][*][p]General improvements to the fight UI, better art, better colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI player/enemy buff items to be more readable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the enemies abilities to be visible on the UI, similar to how you see your own abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a loading screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification for when the game is saved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Here are some pictures explaining the Fight UI[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/6da5fd850ddf74478041258e66aab6348265a30c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/2c7804a2a78647e97114ec4a33293f3df43efe71.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]General fixes [/h3][list][*][p]More content! (new enemy types, new abilities, charms, equipment, potions)[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life improvements in pretty much all areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the forest map with props/buildings, vegetation and new paths you can take (work in progress).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Help section [/h3][p][/p][p]The help section can be used to read more in-depth information about the different mechanics of the game. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/903efa60429207920e62df24cb1b78646f299028.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Potions [/h3][p][/p][p]The shops offer potions for sale! Any obtained potions stay in your inventory. You can use them before a fight to gain a buff to your stats or heal.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some examples of potions, there a several more variants in the game! 😎[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/fd7ae7701bf72b842d0cc555bf313ac3171d2dec.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/0b2eed8fa46fcf22309f22ee32a2ed915ee2bfba.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/d8455d2fb7a3ae153d0495a87e5132218eacb472.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45673704/dea1a8b865ed67b327bde42b3fb3c640e429d228.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]This is just the tip of the iceberg for what's added. 

I will show more progress in the future!   

Thank you for checking out this post, I hope you have a nice day! :) [/p]
